limits: Two real same-origin browser tabs with explicitly synthetic personal notes. Plan/library APIs are actual. Quota denial and malformed existing profile are labelled fixtures. The synchronous snapshot check is best-effort, not atomic compare-and-swap, distributed locking, automatic merge or account sync. Note drafts live in tab memory until saved/exported. No physical-device or human accessibility certification. Only audit contexts bypass CSP.
